run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T08:19:24Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is a downstream symptom of product-catalog having no running pod. Deployment product-catalog was switched to image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 at 2026-11-17T08:19:44Z; the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) was scaled to 0 and the new pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk cannot start because the image pull returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED (ImagePullBackOff). The product-catalog Service (100.69.9.250:8080) therefore has only not-ready endpoints, and its callers fail with gRPC 14 UNAVAILABLE / connection errors to that IP: frontend, recommendation and checkout all record their own error spans on product-catalog operations, frontend returns HTTP 500 to frontend-proxy ("via_upstream" 500s), and frontend-proxy's error span rate rose from 0 to roughly 220-2,200 error spans per 5-minute window. ad and fraud-detection show only small sporadic error counts that also occurred before the change, and the flagd fault flags are all off, so neither is supported as part of this failure. The alerting rule itself and the change actor could not be verified.

claims.text: Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog moved from ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, now 0 replicas) to ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 (image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, 1 replica); events record 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' at 2026-11-17T08:19:44Z and 'Scaled up replica set product-catalog-56fbb5f966 from 0 to 1' at 08:19:52Z.

Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk is Pending with container product-catalog waiting in ImagePullBackOff: 'Back-off pulling image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image ...: 401 UNAUTHORIZED'; its events include Failed/ErrImagePull at 08:19:40Z, BackOff at 08:19:41Z and Failed/ImagePullBackOff at 08:25:07Z.

Deployment product-catalog has no ready or available replicas (readyReplicas/availableReplicas empty with 1 desired) and Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-17T08:19:52Z.
Service product-catalog is clusterIP 100.69.9.250 port 8080 and its Endpoints object holds only notReadyAddresses for pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk (100.96.4.116), with no ready address.

frontend-proxy recorded error spans in both of its operations over 07:19:24-08:34:37: span_name=ingress status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 4573.52 vs 19691.76 UNSET, and span_name='router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 4561.31 vs 19703.97 UNSET.

frontend-proxy error spans were 0 in every 5-minute window from 07:57:24 through 08:19:24, first became non-zero in the window ending 08:20:24 (1.25), reached 221.25 at 08:21:24 and then stayed between about 1,000 and 2,200 per 5 minutes (ingress peak 2196.67 at 08:27:24); the 'router frontend egress' series shows the same onset.

frontend-proxy access logs at 08:29:04-08:29:05Z show HTTP 500 with response flag 'via_upstream' for 'GET /api/products/LS4PSXUNUM' and 'POST /api/checkout', while sibling 'POST /api/cart' and 'GET /api/data' requests returned 200, so the 500 originated with the upstream frontend.

frontend has its own failing product-catalog calls: span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct has rpc.grpc.status_code=14 with grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080 - Local (0.0.0.0:0)', and the parent 'executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId]' and 'GET /api/products/{productId}' spans carry error=true http.status_code=500.

Error spans by operation over the window: frontend GET /api/products/{productId} 3454.5, frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3472.8, frontend grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 659.7, frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 411.9; recommendation /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 663.9 and get_product_list 663.9; checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 414 and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 414 - each failing operation named here targets product-catalog.

Trace error details tie the caller failures to the product-catalog Service IP: checkout span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct carries 'connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.69.9.250:8080: connect: operation not permitted"' with rpc.grpc.status_code=14, and its PlaceOrder parent reports 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"6E92ZMYYFZ"'.

Whole-window error-span increases by service: frontend 18157.97, frontend-proxy 9134.83, recommendation 1331.83, checkout 828, ad 2.04, fraud-detection 3.06, with accounting and payment observed at 0.

The load-generator client records its own error spans for the failing requests (service load-generator, operation GET and POST with error=true, http.status_code=500) in sampled traces such as c7b9c10ff3cb654a5eb850aaa3114ffc and 4a3176aade900727f9cd5a32491c5fda.

ad and fraud-detection show only isolated low-volume error spans that predate the product-catalog change: ad 1.11 in the window ending 08:14:24 and 1.11 ending 08:24:24; fraud-detection 1.11 ending 08:14:24, 1.11 ending 08:24:24 and 1.49 ending 08:34:24; accounting and payment are 0 throughout - this does not track the 08:20-08:21 onset of the frontend-proxy error burst.
The flagd-config ConfigMap entry demo.flagd.json lists 12 fault-injection flags including productCatalogFailure, and every one has defaultVariant 'off' at the time it was read (after the window).

Hypothesis that the flagd productCatalogFailure flag produced the product-catalog errors is rejected: all flagd flags including productCatalogFailure are off in the ConfigMap, and the observed failure path is a connection-level gRPC 14 UNAVAILABLE to the product-catalog Service IP while the product-catalog container has never started, not an application error returned by a running product-catalog.

Hypothesis that frontend-proxy originates the failures is rejected: its 500 responses are logged with flag 'via_upstream' (the frontend's response), its error spans are the ingress and the egress span to frontend, and the failing grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans with gRPC status 14 belong to frontend.

The 'connect EPERM' failures when dialing 100.69.9.250:8080 are consistent with routing to a Service that has no ready endpoints (product-catalog shows only notReadyAddresses); a network-level block cannot be ruled out because the NetworkPolicy query for otel-demo returned no objects, so no policy list could be inspected.

Roll Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog back to a pullable image (the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc used ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog), then confirm the pod becomes Ready, the product-catalog Endpoints object gains ready addresses, and the frontend-proxy ingress and egress 500 spans return to zero.

Trace who or what set the product-catalog image to quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 at 08:19:44Z through the CI/GitOps or audit source, since change history is not available in this Run, and add an admission or pre-rollout check that blocks unpullable images on this Deployment.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run, so the actor/commit that changed Deployment product-catalog to image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 at 08:19:44Z could not be identified.

The alerting rule 'RequestErrorRate' was not returned by the Prometheus rule listing (query returned no rules, status no_data), so its expression, threshold and evaluation interval could not be verified against the reported current value 18.18888888888889.
The NetworkPolicy listing for namespace otel-demo returned no objects (status no_data), so no network policy configuration could be inspected or ruled out.

A filtered frontend log read for 08:15-08:34 (query status no_data) and an unfiltered read for 08:19-08:34 (status no_data) returned no lines, and the product-catalog container never started, so no application log line from either container is available; frontend's failure is evidenced only by its spans.

A filtered checkout log read for 08:19-08:34 read 512 lines through 08:29:05Z and matched none (status no_data), so no checkout log line corroborates its gRPC failures, which are evidenced only by spans.

All other otel-demo deployments show rollout timestamps around 07:46-07:47Z earlier in the window with unchanged image tags, and their pods show 0 restarts; that change is not tied to the error onset at about 08:20 (frontend-proxy errors were 0 until then) and change history is unavailable to attribute it, so it is recorded as a gap rather than impact.

Damage or recovery scope beyond the sampled traces and the metrics window is unknown: the trace views were incomplete (the adapter returned as many traces as requested), and span counts are not unique request counts.
next_steps: Reconcile the product-catalog Deployment image back to the 2.1.3 release image and watch Deployment Available, Endpoints ready addresses and the frontend-proxy error spans.
Retrieve audit/GitOps history for the product-catalog Deployment image change at 2026-11-17T08:19:44Z.
If callers still see 'connect EPERM' to 100.69.9.250:8080 after product-catalog has ready endpoints, inspect NetworkPolicy/CNI configuration in otel-demo.
Inspect the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition in the Prometheus configuration source used for this environment, since the loaded-rule API does not expose it.
